contract: Native value layout consumes persistent checked payload groups, never the currently loaded dependency page.
The page producer owns substitution of record fields and every enum variant payload into complete checked references.
Imported records and enums share payload-reference storage with explicit group boundaries.
Rebuilding an application index must not erase retained layout facts from earlier pages.
Incomplete layouts remain invalid; zero words is a complete empty value.
Newly completed layout inputs participate in closure progress.
verification: existing flat versus split-page constructor execution test in both orders
nested records/enums spanning pages and page order permutations
existing performance workloads after correctness passes
